recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, centered portrait of a man in white streetwear sitting on a rooftop, framed by a massive, industrial billboard structure with bold, red 3D lettering against a clear blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject is centered and grounded, while the billboard looms overhead to create a sense of scale.
The stark white of the clothing contrasts sharply with the deep red of the lettering and the blue sky.
The geometric complexity of the scaffolding contrasts with the soft folds of the subject's clothing.
coreInvariants: Industrial metal scaffolding as a primary background element
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face and jewelry

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, mid-ground, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's hands holding a large, ornate gold and diamond pendant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face/sunglasses, moves down to the jewelry, then follows the scaffolding lines upward to the large red lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners of the frame are clear blue sky, providing breathing room for the heavy industrial elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and bright white (background and clothing).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red (billboard lettering) and black (scaffolding shadows).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and high saturation in the sky and lettering; high value in the clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Massive 3D depth with visible side planes
Slightly irregular, hand-aligned placement on the billboard frame
Uniform stroke weight with sharp corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are integrated into the metal lattice of the billboard structure
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face paired with small, utilitarian metadata blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the billboard look.
Offers a rugged, industrial feel suitable for large-scale signage.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of a man with dreadlocks wearing white sunglasses and a white tracksuit, sitting on a concrete rooftop. Behind him is a massive, empty industrial metal billboard frame against a clear blue sky. High-detail jewelry is visible around his neck.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, 3D red condensed uppercase letters onto the billboard frame. The letters should appear to be physically mounted to the metal lattice with perspective matching the camera angle.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective of the text consistent with the scaffolding?
Is the subject's clothing a clean, bright white?
Does the jewelry have sharp, sparkling highlights?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D text looks integrated, not just pasted on.
Check that the low-angle perspective makes the subject look imposing.
Verify the red of the text is the most saturated color in the image.
Confirm the scaffolding lines lead the eye toward the center.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle urban portrait + industrial billboard frame + 3D condensed display type + high-contrast white/red/blue palette.
